notes.title: Release v1.0.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are finally here. After more than a year of solo development, after 10 months of Early Access, Shapebreaker is ready for a full release!

[h2]How it started[/h2]

The idea started when I wanted to combine the classic Tower Defense genre with modern Roguelike Deckbuilders. The success of Roguelike Tower Defense games showed that there were definitely more people out there that would enjoy such a game, just like me. 

I posted early prototypes on Itch.io. I was pleasantly surprised by the amount of people that enjoyed playing such a bareboned game. It was very motivating and I knew I had to keep working on the game. All the feedback was extremely helpful for understanding what needed to be improved and to determine what was required for an Early Access release. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123277/6c8963577b7b7b315fb87572ca92c4c314f84655.gif[/img]
[h2]Early Access[/h2]

The game released in Early Access on Steam on July 19 last year. This brought in a lot of new players thanks to Steam and content creators like [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b2yAqpOydjw&t=1608s&ab_channel=Retromation]Retromation[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=br3H2768W8Q&t=1s&ab_channel=Wanderbots]Wanderbots[/url]. 

[previewyoutube=b2yAqpOydjw;full][/previewyoutube]

Since the start of Early Access new content was added like:
[list]
[*] Act 3 with a unique boss
[*] Branching act paths
[*] Challenge decks
[*] Difficulty modes
[*] Elites
[*] New cards
[*] New curios
[*] New curios
[*] Events
[*] Steam achievements
[*] Support for various aspect ratios.
[/list]
[h2]What now?[/h2]

The roadmap for v1.1 and onward will be determined by the feedback I receive on v1.0. Definitely let me know what you like, like less and would like to see on [url=https://discord.gg/EKxcb63DvP]Discord[/url] and the Steam discussion forums. 

[h2]Thank you[/h2]

A big thank you to everyone that played Shapebreaker during development. It really fueled development and shaped the roadmap. The game would not be the same without you. Thank you!

Enjoy!
Alexander

notes.title: New release date - May 2, 2023
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I have decided to move the release date for Shapebreaker from February 21 to May 2. 
I want to deliver a high quality full release and this will no longer be possible to achieve by February 21. There are multiple factors playing a role here which I would like to clarify below.

First of all I misjudged the impact of becoming a father. I knew that taking care of a child would take a lot of time and energy, but it's taking even more than I thought. My nights have been thoroughly and structurally invaded by my little baby girl and her constant requirement for sustenance. Even though my night rests are slowly being restored to an acceptable state, my original schedule for the game can not be recuperated.  I do want to stress that my lack of energy has not impacted my motivation. I am more motivated than ever to work on the game and I am very excited about the journey to bring it to a successful full release. 

Secondly I have been receiving a lot of positive feedback about the game. There are so many people that love the idea behind the game, that love playing it and would love to see it grow.  As development on the game progresses so does my vision for what game should contain for a full release. Development on the game will require more time before this vision can be fully implemented.

So for these reasons it is in the best interest of the game to postpone the full release until May 2. 
Thank you all for playing the game and providing feedback. I look forward to continuing this journey to full release and beyond!

Hi everyone,

Version 0.3.17 of the game is now live. This is the post-competition update. I've added the curio Scrap recycler designed together with competition winner Chuckjirka. I've Also made some changes based on the dominant strategy and bugs exposed by the competition. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42123277/30d0730d99954e746a813e08129ec95b2e01da02.png[/img]

Chuckjirka was looking forward to providing the Berserk element with some way to scale up. Chuckjirka also really likes effects that trigger when your deck is reshuffled. We combined these two ideas and thus Scrap recycler was born! 

Patch notes:
• Added a new curio Scrap recycler. The curio increases the current and maximum life of your core by 1 each time your deck is reshuffled into your draw deck. 
• The Frost tooltip now properly indicates that Frost can stack on shapes. This was originally a bug but is now a feature. 
• Increased the duration of Frost from 0.75 seconds to 1 second and decreased the slow effect from 30% to 25%. This averages out to a small improvement. 
• Frost now has 50% reduced duration on bosses. 
• Decreased the attack speed bonus of Moon from 30% to 25%. 
• Reduced the health of Vessel shapes and shapes spawned by Vessel shapes by 5%.
• Added an extra key binding for changing game speed: The + and - keys.
• Opening the escape menu during a wave now pauses the game.
• Fixed a bug that caused cards drawn to be different before and after opening a saved playthrough.

• A playthrough is now generated based on a seed. The seed is now displayed on the bottom right of the screen during a run. This does not currently affect players but it allows me to more easily recreate situations based on bug reports. 

Got any feedback? Help improve the game by sharing by pressing F8 in-game, on the discussion forums on Steam or on [url=https://discord.gg/EKxcb63DvP]Discord[/url]. 

Enjoy!
Alexander

notes.title: Update v0.3.12
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Version 0.3.12 of the game is now live. I've added the much requested key bindings.

Patch notes:
• Added key binding for ending your turn: SPACE
• Added key bindings for increasing and decreasing game speed: Q/A/UP-ARROW for decreasing speed, E/DOWN-ARROW for increasing speed. 
• Added key bindings for selecting a card during a map: The numbers 1 to 9
• Added key bindings for choosing a card reward: The numbers 1 to 3
• Added the total amount of waves to the wave counter on top of the map screen. 
• Slightly moved UI elements around on top of the screen to improve consistency. 
• Fixed a grammatical error in the description of the Enrage tooltip.
